note: No framework is named or attributed to Oprah Winfrey in this pack, because none has been verified against her published work. Section 7.1 forbids inventing a named framework to meet a quantity target. When source supply lands, each framework is extracted from verified source records with preconditions, how to apply, limits, questions to ask, counterexamples, and evidence needed, or is explicitly labeled a BlackCEO adaptation.

planned_contents.planned_content: Compare the client's stated intention with the likely impact of the choice.
Identify the human story inside the decision and what the people it serves need in order to feel understood.
Distinguish external validation from meaningful progress.
Trace relational and reputational consequences concretely: whose trust, what promise, and what behavior.
